channel.title: Islam Darawsheh Articles
channel.description: Practical articles on software architecture, enterprise .NET, secure systems, and maintainable software design.

item.title: Stop Exposing EF Core Entities from Your .NET 10 APIs
item.description: A production-minded .NET 10 guide to separating EF Core entities from HTTP API contracts using explicit request/response models, projections, TypedResults, and ProblemDetails.

item.title: Clean Architecture in .NET 10: Stop Adding Layers, Start Protecting Decisions
item.description: A production-minded .NET 10 walkthrough of Clean Architecture using UUIDv7, strong domain types, authoritative pricing, EF Core boundaries, Minimal APIs, and focused tests without unnecessary ceremony.

item.title: Clean Architecture vs. DDD Is Usually the Wrong Question
item.description: Clean Architecture and Domain-Driven Design are not competing alternatives. One governs dependency direction; the other helps teams model complex business domains.
